releases.name: v0.3.1
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* First post-jam update
* Japanese translation by @TRSasasusu
* Put the floor back on in later parts of the mod
* Minor animation tweaks

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Hawkbat/ow-wrong-warp-nh-jam/compare/0.3.0...0.3.1
releases.bodyZh:
## 有何改动
* 首个Jam后更新
* 日文翻译由@TRSasasusu提供
* 在模组后期的部分恢复了地板
* 对动画进行了微调

**完整变更日志**: https://github.com/Hawkbat/ow-wrong-warp-nh-jam/compare/0.3.0...0.3.1

releases.name: v0.3.0
releases.body:
- Added animations to the various gears
- Added a ceiling window to the entry corridor
- Fixed a geometry collision issue
releases.bodyZh:
- 为各种齿轮添加了动画效果
- 在入口走廊添加了天花板窗户

releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.body:
- Made black holes 93% less deadly, to avoid repeating long load times
- Added fuel canisters in certain locations
- Minor tweaks and graphical fixes
releases.bodyZh:
- 黑洞伤害降低93%，避免重复长时间加载时间
- 在特定地点添加了燃料罐
- 进行了一些微调并修复了图形问题
